steps.title: Open your PDF and highlight the data.
steps.body: Open a statement, invoice, or report in the PDF Converter and draw over the data you need with the Rectangle tool. Each highlight gets its own color, which you can use to tell sections apart later.

steps.title: Add column guides, if you need them.
steps.body: Place guides where columns should split. Skip them and Altera works out the columns itself, page by page.

steps.title: Click Convert.
steps.body: Your highlighted areas become a clean table, ready to send into a workflow.

steps.title: This is a node.
steps.body: Nodes do one job on your data: filter rows, clean text, merge tables, total a column, and more.

steps.title: Connect nodes into a workflow.
steps.body: Data flows from left to right. The table extracted from your PDF goes in, and each node passes its result to the next.

steps.title: You decide when to run it.
steps.body: Run the workflow and watch each node turn green as it finishes. Change a setting and re-run it any time.

steps.title: Clean and filter your data…
steps.body: For example, keeping only last month's transactions from a bank statement.

steps.title: …total it by group…
steps.body: For example, adding up spend per supplier across a stack of invoices.

steps.title: …or combine two sources.
steps.body: For example, matching a bank statement against your ledger export to find what doesn't line up.

steps.title: And it's intuitive.
steps.body: No formulas and no scripts: pick a node, set its options, and see the result. Most people build their first workflow in an afternoon.

allFaqs.label: What types of PDFs does Altera support?
allFaqs.text: Altera works with any PDF — payslips, invoices, bank statements, reports, and more. If it has structured data, Altera can extract it.

allFaqs.label: How accurate is the extraction?
allFaqs.text: Altera extracts data with high accuracy. You can define custom rules to ensure every field maps exactly where you need it.

allFaqs.label: Do I need to install anything?
allFaqs.text: Altera is a standalone desktop app. Download the installer for Windows or macOS and you're ready to start extracting in seconds — no other software required.

allFaqs.label: Can I process multiple PDFs at once?
allFaqs.text: Yes. Altera supports batch processing so you can drop in hundreds of PDFs and get all the data structured in one go.

allFaqs.label: Is my data secure?
allFaqs.text: Your files are processed securely and never stored beyond the active session. We don't share or retain your data.

allFaqs.label: Can I try it before paying?
allFaqs.text: Absolutely — you can start for free and explore the core features before committing to a plan.

allFaqs.label: Do I need programming knowledge to use Altera?
allFaqs.text: Not at all. Altera is designed to be used entirely visually — you drag, drop, and configure — no code required.

allFaqs.label: Can Altera handle scanned or image-based PDFs?
allFaqs.text: Altera works best with digitally generated PDFs. Scanned documents with OCR-readable text are also supported, though accuracy may vary depending on scan quality.

allFaqs.label: What output format does the extracted data come in?
allFaqs.text: Altera outputs clean, structured tables directly in the app — ready to analyse, export, or feed into your next workflow step.

allFaqs.label: Can I use different nodes for different document types?
allFaqs.text: Yes. Each node is purpose-built for a specific extraction task. You can mix and match nodes in the same workflow to handle different document types in one pass.

allFaqs.label: What if the extraction misses a field or gets it wrong?
allFaqs.text: You can define custom extraction rules to handle edge cases. If a specific document structure isn't covered out of the box, we also offer custom node development.

allFaqs.label: Is there a file size limit?
allFaqs.text: Altera handles standard business documents without issue. Very large files or unusually complex layouts may affect processing time, but there is no hard cap.

allFaqs.label: What languages are supported?
allFaqs.text: Altera primarily supports English and French documents. Support for additional languages is being added as the suite grows.

allFaqs.label: How do I get support if something goes wrong?
allFaqs.text: You can reach us directly at support@alteradatasuite.com. We're a small team so you'll always get a real response — not a bot.

finance.title: Reconcile bank statements against your ledger
finance.summary: Turn PDF bank statements into clean tables and match them against your ledger export, so only the entries that need attention are left.
finance.metaDescription: Extract transactions from PDF bank statements and reconcile them against your ledger export with a no-code Altera workflow.
finance.lead: Month-end reconciliation usually means copying transactions out of PDF statements by hand. With Altera, you extract them, match them against your ledger, and keep only what doesn't line up.
documents: Ledger or accounting exports (Excel or CSV)
finance.challenge: Statements arrive as PDFs, in a different layout for every bank. Copying them into a spreadsheet takes hours, and one mistyped amount is enough to throw off the whole reconciliation.

steps.title: Extract the transactions
steps.body: Highlight the transaction table in the PDF Converter, and Altera turns it into rows of date, description, reference, and amount.

steps.title: Clean the text
steps.body: Trim spaces and strip currency symbols, so amounts and references match exactly.

steps.title: Make amounts numeric
steps.body: Convert the amount column to numbers, so it can be compared and totalled.

steps.title: Match against the ledger
steps.body: Load your ledger export with Input Data and connect it to Merge's Extra Data port. Rows are matched on reference and amount.

steps.title: Keep what needs attention
steps.body: Filter down to the entries with no match, and export them to Excel for review.

outcomes: Reconcile a month of transactions in minutes instead of hours
No retyping, so no typos in amounts
Reuse the same workflow next month: swap the PDF and run it again

about.heroHeading: Built by a small team with a clear goal.
about.heroLead: Altera Data Suite was created to solve a problem we kept running into — extracting structured data from PDFs shouldn't require hours of manual work or complex scripts. So we built a tool that does it in seconds.
about.story1Text: We both came from consulting backgrounds — working with firms including Deloitte and PwC. One thing became clear fast: even at that level, nobody had built a proper all-in-one solution for extracting data from PDFs. Payslips, invoices, reports — everything was handled manually or with fragile one-off scripts. That gap was the starting point.
about.story2Text: We started with a single PDF converter node. It worked — and immediately we saw what was missing next. Getting a table out of a PDF was only step one; cleaning it, reshaping it, and getting it ready to actually use took just as long. So we kept building. Each new node was a direct response to a friction point in real workflows.
about.story3Text: The early versions were built to run inside another company's software. That got us moving fast, but it also meant living within someone else's constraints. So we rebuilt Altera as its own desktop app — full control over speed, design, and the experience end to end, with nothing else to install first.
about.story4Text: The suite is still growing. More nodes are in development, and existing ones are actively maintained. This isn't a finished product — it's an evolving toolkit built to keep pace with how data work actually happens.
about.ctaHeading: Ready to see it in action?
about.ctaSubtitle: Watch the demo to see how Altera handles real PDFs, or explore the pricing to find the plan that fits.

whyWorkflows.heading: Why visual workflows?
whyWorkflows.lead: Altera turns every step of your data work into a node you can see, check, and reuse. Here's why we built it that way.
intro: Most data work still happens in spreadsheets full of formulas, or in scripts written by the one person on the team who codes. Both work — until you need to check a number, change a step, or hand the job to someone else.

The problem is that both hide the process. A script is a list of instructions; a spreadsheet only shows the final result. But when you're turning a stack of PDFs into a report, what you really care about is the data itself — what it looks like after each step, and whether it's right.

That's why Altera is built around a data flow. Each node does one job — extract, clean, filter, combine, summarize — and you can open any node to see its output. The workflow is the process, laid out where everyone can see it.
whyWorkflows.diagramCaption: A real payroll workflow: the table extracted from the PDF is split into employee rows and pay dates, each side is cleaned, then they're joined back together and exported to Excel.
whyWorkflows.reasonsIntro: Three reasons we believe visual workflows are the best way to work with data:

reasons.title: You care about the result, not the code
body: When you summarize invoices by supplier, the questions that matter are which rows to keep, how to group them, and what to total. How that's written in code doesn't help you answer any of them.
In Altera you pick a node, set its options, and see the result right away. Every setting is a visible choice, not a line of syntax you have to debug.

reasons.title: A workflow everyone can read
body: A workflow is a shared language. A finance lead, an analyst, and an auditor can all look at the same canvas and follow what happens to the data, step by step, without reading a script.
That makes it easy to review someone's work, hand a process over when a colleague is away, and show exactly how a figure in a report was produced.

reasons.title: No coding degree required
body: You can build your first useful workflow in an afternoon: extract a table from a PDF, clean it up, and export it to Excel.
From there you learn one node at a time. The same canvas that handles a simple cleanup also handles merges, pivots, regular expressions, and multi-step reports, so you never outgrow it.

different.title: PDF extraction is part of the workflow
different.body: Most tools start once your data is already in a table. In Altera, extracting data from PDFs is a node like any other, so getting the data out and cleaning it up happen in one place.

different.title: Build once, run it again every month
different.body: Save a workflow and every setting is kept, including the areas you highlighted on the PDF. When next month's file arrives, swap it in and run the same steps again.

different.title: Your files stay on your computer
different.body: Altera is a desktop app. Your documents are processed locally on your own machine, not uploaded to someone else's server.
